props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the icon button, and the popover's title.

props.name: tone
props.description: Picks the glyph: info (i), help (?), alert (!). Alert tooltips turn red.

props.name: type
props.description: `popover` opens a titled note on click; `tooltip` shows the body on hover.

components.name: QuestionIcon
components.description: Preset of InfoIcon with the help (?) glyph, for "what is this?" notes next to a field or title. Same as `<InfoIcon tone="help">`; takes every other InfoIcon prop, including `type`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the icon button, and the popover's title.

props.description: `popover` opens a titled note on click; `tooltip` shows the body on hover.

examples.title: type tooltip · tone alert
examples.code:
<InfoIcon
  type="tooltip"
  tone="alert"
  label="Overdue"
  body="Invoice is 14 days late."
/>

examples.title: QuestionIcon preset · type tooltip

  type="tooltip"

/>
